ops.title: Module-wide: comment lines on unexported identifiers violate STYLEGUIDE
ops.description:
Raised 2026-08-01 by the P4.2a2 refuter, flagged honestly as a module-wide issue rather than a lane
regression.

STYLEGUIDE.md § Comments says godoc goes on exported types, funcs, and the package, and "unexported
helpers get none". The module does not follow this: `ensure.go` is saturated with comments on
unexported identifiers, `ci/exportcensus/main.go` comments `census`/`collect`/`scan`/`report`,
`deploy/deploy_test.go` carries 134 comment lines, and `program.go`'s own `build`/`resolved` carried
such comments before phase 4 touched them.

So a lane that adds one is matching the file it is in — which AGENTS.md also instructs — while
violating the guide. The two rules disagree, and every review pass re-litigates it.

Resolve it one way: either sweep the module to the stated rule, or amend the rule to describe what
the module actually does (e.g. godoc-shaped comments permitted on unexported identifiers where they
say something the signature does not). Do not leave both texts standing.

Also from the same review: an upgrade now costs three full reads of the executable (Stable source,
place target, place source) and a no-op costs two, versus one before, plus an os.ReadDir of the
shared program root per Ensure. On the Ensure path, not a hot path — recorded, not urgent.

ops.text: A sweep removes comments on unexported identifiers that are not TODOs or non-obvious workarounds
Either STYLEGUIDE's rule holds across the module, or the rule is amended to match the module's actual convention
